summary: ZCode's official verified X account (@zcode_ai) announced Weekend Build IV on Sep 4, 2026: 300M free GLM-5.3-Flash tokens per person, claimable in the ZCode desktop app via the bottom-left event card. The event opens Sat Sep 5, 09:00 Beijing time (Fri 6 PM PT / 9 PM ET) and — per the official poster attached to the post — the window runs SAT 09:00 – SUN 23:00 UTC+8, i.e. through Sunday Sep 6, 2026. Claims are instant and first come, first served, so the pool can exhaust before the window closes; restart the app if the card is missing. This is a separate event from the ongoing ZCode Global Build (nightly till Sep 20, +100M for new users) already listed as zcode-glm-5-3-flash-free; the official site's changelog independently corroborates the in-app Weekend/Global Plan claim-card feature.
claim_steps: Install and open the ZCode desktop app from https://zcode.z.ai (macOS, Windows, and Linux builds available), or update/restart your existing install.
Sign in with your Z.ai account in ZCode.
After the event opens — Sat Sep 5, 09:00 Beijing time (Fri 6 PM PT / 9 PM ET) — look for the Weekend Build IV card in the bottom-left of the app.
If the card is not visible, restart the app.
Tap the card and claim instantly: 300M GLM-5.3-Flash tokens per person.
Claim early — tokens are first come, first served, and the window runs to Sun 23:00 UTC+8 (Sep 6, 2026).
